topic.title: Fluenta DITA Translation Add-on (Discontinued)
topic.shortdesc: The Fluenta DITA Translation add-on lets you manage the Fluenta translation workflow for DITA projects directly from Oxygen.

note.p: The Fluenta DITA Translation add-on has been discontinued and will receive no further updates. Development has ended following changes to the Fluenta licensing model. This final release preserves support for the last open-source Fluenta version available before those licensing changes.
Existing installations will continue to function, but no bug fixes, compatibility updates, or new features will be provided.

body.note:
This add-on is compatible with the following products:
Oxygen XML Editor
Oxygen XML Author
